Class PendingGame

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.PendingGame
public class PendingGame extends Object
Holds lobby state before a match starts, including join order and totem assignments.

      public PendingGame(String gameId, int requiredPlayers)
      Creates an empty lobby for a game expecting the given number of players.
      Parameters:
      gameId - the game identifier
      requiredPlayers - the number of players required to start

  • Method Details

    • addPlayer

      public Totem addPlayer(String playerName, Totem requestedTotem)
      Adds a player to the lobby and assigns the requested totem.
      Parameters:
      playerName - the player's nickname
      requestedTotem - the totem/color requested by the player
      Returns:
      the assigned totem
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the nickname is null/blank or already used, or if the requested totem is null/occupied
      IllegalStateException - if the lobby is full

    • registerPending

      public void registerPending(String playerName)
      Registers a nickname as pending totem selection.
      Parameters:
      playerName - nickname to register

    • removePending

      public void removePending(String playerName)
      Removes a player nickname waiting for totem confirmation.
      Parameters:
      playerName - nickname to remove from pending registrations
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if nickname is null/blank or not currently pending

    • removePlayer

      public void removePlayer(Totem totem)
      Removes a confirmed player by totem and frees that totem for selection again.
      Parameters:
      totem - totem assigned to the player that must be removed
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if totem is null or no joined player owns it

      public boolean isFull()
      Indicates whether the lobby has reached its required player count.

    • isPending

      public boolean isPending(String playerName)
      Returns whether a player is registered as pending totem selection.

      Returns:
      true if the player has entered the lobby but not yet selected a totem
